'''Loth''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="GG2-2" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Loth system/Legends|Loth system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The natural structures known as [[rubygrub cyst]]s could be found there.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loth was introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Loth [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square J-8.<ref name="TEA" />
